fusions.name: Iron-Tyred Rush
fusions.desc: Rushes you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then through a cone 3 tiles long that deals 13 damage to everything in it. Its damage rises 6% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Flung Buckler
fusions.desc: Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back. Throws a round shield at the first enemy it meets, which deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Glancing Plates
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Spoked Cuirass
fusions.desc: Gives you a cuirass: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10% and you move 5% faster.
